offering_description.value: Upland sells software for managing business documents and knowledge, running sales and marketing campaigns, and coordinating projects and IT operations. It serves enterprises and public-sector organizations, primarily through cloud subscriptions, and provides implementation and training.

primary_products.value: Document workflow and cloud fax software; enterprise search and knowledge management software; sales enablement and proposal software; digital marketing and customer engagement software; project portfolio and IT expense management software

primary_services.value: Software implementation; configuration and integration consulting; user training

customer_segment.value: B2B: Enterprise sales, marketing, customer service, IT and operations teams; B2G: Public agencies with document management and workflow needs

end_markets.value: Financial services; healthcare; technology and professional services; media and publishing; government

revenue_model.value: subscription: Recurring access to enterprise software applications; service fees: Implementation, integration and training; transaction or usage fees: Fax transmission volume on metered plans
revenue_model.category: subscription; service fees; transaction or usage fees

value_chain_position.value: software / platform: Develops applications that process business documents, knowledge and workflow data for enterprise and public-sector teams; service provider: Configures and integrates its applications into customers’ existing systems

geography_served.value: global: North America, Europe and other international markets

specialization.value: related lines: Document workflows, knowledge management, sales and marketing, customer engagement, project management and IT expense management

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: Enterprise account teams and product demonstrations; partners / resellers: Software resellers and implementation partners

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: Customer data processing under GDPR and applicable US privacy laws
